lesson.title: Place the mirror
lesson.subtitle: P4 symmetry revision
lesson.objective: Choose a mirror line that reflects a shape onto itself.
lesson.story: Choose a line to move the mirror. Which line reflects the shape onto itself? Undo and the optional hint preview are practice aids.

steps.title: Place the mirror
steps.prompt: Choose a line to move the mirror. Which line reflects the shape onto itself? Undo and the optional hint preview are practice aids.

choices.label: Line B: straight across through the middle
Line C: from bottom-left to top-right corner
Line D: from top-left to bottom-right corner
Line A: straight down through the middle

hints: Imagine folding the shape along the line.
The hint preview shows a reflected outline; compare it by eye.
Try the line through the matching left and right halves.

steps.title: Another way to check
steps.prompt: Without the preview, how many lines of symmetry does this shape have altogether?
hints: Do not count a line twice.

steps.title: Explain your thinking

choices.label: Matching points are the same distance from the mirror, on opposite sides.
Every point moves one square to the right, so the shape keeps its look.
Any line through the middle of a shape makes a mirror image of it.

hints: The mirror lies between each matching pair.
Both points are the same distance from it.
Choose the explanation about equal distances on opposite sides.
